summary: AI2 Incubator is active with rolling admissions for applied AI founders; official pages publish a live application form, funding, cloud credits, and hybrid/remote support but no fixed cohort dates.

proposed_event.name: AI2 Incubator
proposed_event.description: Rolling AI startup incubator with funding, cloud credits, technical support, and company-building help.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling admissions start anytime; 12 months of company-building support. No fixed cohort dates or deadline published.

sources.title: AI2 Incubator homepage
sources.supports: Official homepage describes AI2 Incubator as supporting AI-first startups; states up to $600,000 funding at a $10M cap, up to $1,000,000 in cloud credits, 12 months of company-building, about 15 startups per year, remote support with quarterly Seattle visits or Seattle relocation, and Seattle/AI House location.

sources.title: Apply to AI2 Incubator
sources.supports: Official application page is live and says AI2 Incubator partners with technical founders and domain experts to build applied AI companies; it provides a multi-step application form and does not publish a deadline.

sources.title: AI2 Incubator Framework
sources.supports: Official framework page states rolling admissions start anytime, no relocation is required, and the program serves technical founders and domain experts building applied AI companies.

sources.title: AI2 Incubator Team
sources.supports: Official team page describes the incubator as born inside the Allen Institute for AI in 2014 and independent since 2022, supporting organizer and program background.

notes: No exact application deadline, program start, program end, or demo day was visible on the official homepage, framework page, or application page as of 2026-06-09.
Official current funding terms differ from the imported source context: the homepage now states up to $600,000 in funding at a $10M cap, plus up to $1,000,000 in free non-dilutive cloud credits.
